interpretation: The ordinary receive session feeds matching bridge PCM into the container monitor. The shared host path has smooth relative drift of about 0.258 ms/s, roughly 27 ms over 117 seconds, with about 3.3 ms maximum residual. This supports the host tunnel/loopback as a common timing difference, but it is not proof that this drift caused any specific missing card.
